description: The total price of one stay for a party, with its breakdown (nights, length discount, extra-guest fee, cleaning) – the same calculation that charges the guest. Amounts are integer cents. When the stay cannot be booked the answer has ok:false and a reason: unavailable (with the taken dates), min_stay (with minStay), no_checkin_day, no_checkout_day, max_guests (with maxGuests), no_rates or invalid_range. A quote holds nothing.

checkOut.description: Departure, YYYY-MM-DD (that night is not included)

slug.description: The place's slug – the last part of its page URL (posadita.com/p/{slug}), or from search_stays or /llms.txt.

name: get_quote
